messages:
elaine_sales: Medibase POC - intermittent 502/504s only when Python streaming requests run through customer forward-proxy. TS frontend OK if it disables streaming. Demo tomorrow, need quick triage.
ben_engineering: can you confirm SDK versions + whether proxy is doing TLS termination or mTLS between client and proxy? Those change connection reuse semantics.
elaine_sales: python sdk 1.0.0 (requests), ts sdk 1.2.0. Customer says proxy requires client cert to the proxy (mTLS) and injects auth headers. They set HTTPS_PROXY and use a local cert. NO_PROXY not set.
ben_engineering: two immediate suspects: 1) proxy session limits + long-lived stream keepalives, 2) proxy altering chunked transfer behavior. Workarounds: use a pooled Session with HTTPAdapter and explicit keepalive, reduce concurrent streams per process, and test bypass with NO_PROXY.
priya_support: sample python pattern we give customers:
```
import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
s = requests.Session()
s.mount('https://', HTTPAdapter(pool_maxsize=50, pool_block=True))
s.headers.update({'Connection': 'keep-alive'})
# also set retry/backoff
```
ben_engineering: node hint: ensure http.Agent has keepAlive and maxSockets tuned. If proxy terminates TLS and opens new backend connections, mixing clients can cause backend bursts and proxy queueing.
ravi_sre: capture socket counts (netstat) on client box and proxy TCP logs. Look for many TIME_WAIT and ephemeral ports exhausted. Also check proxy per-IP concurrent connection caps and whether it multiplexes HTTP/2 upstream.
secops_bot: privacy note: we log source IP at edge and short-lived request IDs; we do not persist full request headers by default. For regulated POCs recommend Private deployment or a dedicated ingress with controlled logging.
elaine_sales: customer asked whether Dedicated helps. ben?
ben_engineering: Dedicated reduces our multi-tenant variability but won't bypass their proxy. Private (VPC peering or on-prem) removes the corporate proxy from the path. For immediate demo, focus on client keepalive + NO_PROXY test.
priya_support: action items: ben -> push small repro snippets (python + node) and a toggle script for NO_PROXY; ravi -> request proxy connection limits/logs from customer; secops_bot -> provide short FAQ on logs/PII; elaine -> ask Medibase to run repro and share netstat/TCP dumps before the demo.
elaine_sales: tagging @medibase-ops for logs and NO_PROXY test. Will report back in this thread. Thanks team!
